key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:07CE
name: build_entry_offset_table
description: Walks a table of 32-bit entries, looks up each entry's position in that table, and records a word offset and width into two arrays. Then it calls a library routine to get a block and copies a linked list of records into it.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:080E
name: record_matched_entry_offset
description: Scans a table for a value matching the current entry, stores a long at a word-indexed slot when it matches, and then resumes the shared scan loop. It is a fragment of the larger table builder.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0824
name: fill_offset_pairs_and_list
description: Continues the table scan: stores matched values, computes running offsets, and when the scan finishes it allocates a block through a library call and copies a record list into it.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0892
name: accumulate_running_offsets
description: Computes running totals over a table of entries, writing each total with its width into a per-entry slot. It then copies a record list into a newly allocated block when the scan is complete.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:08E6
name: emit_record_list_block
description: When a flag is nonzero, writes a header tag of 2 and a pointer, counts records from a library list, allocates a block, and copies the list into it. It then releases a library resource.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:08F0
name: build_record_list_block
description: Writes a header tag of 2 and a pointer, counts records from a library list, allocates a block, and copies the list into it. It then releases a library resource.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:095E
name: clear_two_longs_and_close
description: Clears two longs at the given pointer, calls a library routine, and calls an unnamed routine. It returns the base offset plus twelve on failure, or zero on success.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0988
name: call_helper_return_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine with no arguments and returns zero. It is a thin wrapper around that unnamed routine.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:098E
name: free_entry_list_and_block
description: Frees a linked list of nodes one by one through a library call. If a second block is given, it frees that block's sub-block when present, then frees the block itself.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0994
name: free_node_list_and_block
description: Frees a linked list of nodes one by one through a library call. If a second block is given, it frees that block's sub-block when present, then frees the block itself.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:09B4
name: release_block_with_subblock
description: Frees the sub-block of a structure if one is attached, then calls a library routine and frees the structure itself. It does nothing when the pointer is null.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:09F2
name: negate_library_result_if_negative
description: Calls a library routine for a word result and negates that result when the input word is negative. The return value keeps the sign of the input.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0A1C
name: multiply_signed_32bit_to_64bit
description: Multiplies two signed 32-bit values by splitting each into 16-bit halves, sums the partial products, and fixes the sign of the 64-bit result. It returns the product as two longs.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0A6C
name: append_name_entry_to_buffer
description: Measures a zero-terminated name, optionally searches an existing string list for a match, and writes a fixed-size record with the name and its fields into a buffer. It copies the name in when there is no match, and returns one on success or zero when the buffer has no room.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0AA8
name: store_name_entry_record
description: Searches a list of strings for the name, and when no match is found writes a fixed-size name record and the copied name into a buffer. It returns one on success or zero when the buffer has no room.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0AB2
name: store_entry_after_name_match
description: Compares the name with a string list and, on a match, continues into the shared record-writing code, otherwise it advances to the next string. It returns one on success or zero when the buffer has no room.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0AC8
name: store_name_entry_after_scan
description: Advances through a string list comparing names, and when the scan ends it writes a fixed-size name record into a buffer and optionally a copied list of two-long entries. It returns one on success or zero when the buffer is full.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0B02
name: store_entry_with_list_copy
description: Counts the entries in a library-provided list, allocates a block large enough for them, and copies the list into it. It then writes the name record pointing at that block and returns one on success or zero when the buffer is full.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0B5A
name: store_entry_list_copy
description: Scans a list of two-long entries for a match and, when the flag and pointer are set, copies the list into a freshly allocated block. It writes the name record and returns one on success or zero when out of space.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0B66
name: store_entry_list_skip_match
description: Walks a list of two-long entries, skipping over equal entries until a mismatch, then writes the name record and copies the remaining list. It returns one on success or zero when out of space.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0B98
name: scan_list_then_store_entry
description: Steps through a list of two-long entries comparing each against the current one, and when the scan ends it writes the name record and optionally a copied list. It returns one on success or zero when the buffer has no room.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0BD8
name: store_entry_record_with_pointer
description: Reserves ten bytes in the output buffer and writes the name record, storing either a supplied pointer or a copied list of two-long entries. It returns one on success or zero when the buffer has no room.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0C1E
name: write_name_record_fields
description: Copies the name bytes into the record, fills in the record's fields from the entry data, and either stores a supplied pointer or copies a list. It always returns one.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0C46
name: fill_entry_record_fields
description: Writes the record's source address, flag and width fields, then either stores a supplied pointer or copies a list. It always returns one.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0CAE
name: copy_two_long_list_terminated
description: Copies each two-long entry from a library-provided list into a destination array and ends it with a zero entry. It always returns one.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0CD2
name: store_record_pointer_return_one
description: Stores a supplied value into one fixed field of a record and returns one. It has no other effect.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0CD8
name: copy_entry_flag_into_record
description: Copies the flag byte from the entry into the record with its top bit cleared, then returns one.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0CEE
name: return_zero_stub
description: Does nothing and returns zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0D0C
name: enumerate_matching_font_entries
description: Walks the list of font entries and counts those whose flags match the request. When the flags ask for it, it also scans font files through library calls and records the matches in the output buffer, returning a count.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0D42
name: scan_font_directory_entries
description: Counts font entries that match the request flags and, when the directory flag is set, scans font files on disk through library calls, checking each name for a period. Matching font records are written to the output buffer.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0D86
name: scan_font_directory_fragment
description: Continues the font scan from the directory loop: it counts matching entries, then scans file names for a period and writes the matched records into the output buffer. It is a shared tail of the directory scanner.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0D98
name: scan_fonts_directory_for_files
description: References the FONTS: directory and counts matching font entries. It scans the directory through library calls, checks names for a period, writes the matched records, and returns the count negated when the result is negative.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0E5A
name: scan_font_files_for_records
description: Walks a directory listing through library calls, splits each file name at a period, and writes matching font records into the output buffer. It returns a count of records, negated when negative.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0EE4
name: match_dot_font_file_entries
description: Checks each directory entry whose name ends in a period-separated font extension and writes the matching records into a buffer. It returns the match count, negated when negative.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0F4E
name: write_font_entry_loop_tail
description: Continues the font file loop by writing each matching entry and advancing to the next one, then closes the scan through library calls. It returns the count, negated when negative.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0F70
name: advance_font_entry_records
description: Advances through the font record table and writes each matching entry, then closes the directory scan through library calls. It returns the count, negated when negative.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:0FEE
name: read_font_tag_flags
description: Reads font records with the font and tag extensions, sets flag bits from their size and style values when limits are exceeded, and writes the matching records into the output buffer.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:11AC
name: read_font_style_flags
description: Sets style flag bits on each font entry from size and tag values read through library calls, then writes the entries into the output buffer and returns a count.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1234
name: enumerate_fonts_directory_records
description: References the FONTS: directory and walks its entries through library calls, building a font record for each match and returning a count, negated when negative. Several other routines call it.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1310
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero immediately without any other work.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:131C
name: read_diskfont_env_settings
description: Reads the diskfont environment settings through library calls and copies each pair of values into two pairs of fields in the structure. It does nothing when the initial library call fails.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:134E
name: read_dpi_template_arguments
description: Reads the X and Y DPI, dot pitch and symbol set arguments through library calls, storing the first two values into one pair of fields and the next two into another. It loops until the argument list ends.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:145C
name: load_font_file_entries
description: Takes a font filename, rejects names too long to store, and splits off the extension. When it is the font extension, it loads the matching font records from disk and appends them to a list, then returns the new list head.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1554
name: append_font_entries_from_list
description: Walks a list of font records and, for each entry of the matching type, allocates a new record, copies its name and attributes, and appends it. It uses library calls for the directory walk.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1642
name: build_font_list_and_release
description: Builds a list of font records from the directory scan, copying each entry's name and attributes into fixed-size slots. It then releases the temporary lists through library calls and returns the list head.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1690
name: collect_font_records_from_scan
description: Walks the directory scan through library calls, allocates a record for each font entry, copies its name and attribute fields into it, and links the records into a list.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1700
name: finish_font_record_block
description: Writes the header of the final font record, copies the stored entries into it in fixed-size slots, then frees the temporary list and returns the record head.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1740
name: copy_font_entries_and_release
description: Copies each linked entry of a header plus 64 words into one contiguous array, then frees the temporary list and returns the array head.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1770
name: free_font_list_and_return
description: Frees each node of a temporary linked list through library calls, releases the working resources, and returns the stored head pointer.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:17E4
name: load_otag_font_data
description: Loads the font data file named in the buffer through library calls and adjusts the offset values flagged with the high bit so they point into the loaded block. It returns the block, or zero when loading fails.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:18BC
name: open_library_file_with_tags
description: Finds a library file named in the buffer and adds the base offset to flagged table entries. It then opens the file through a tagged library call, releases the handle on failure, and returns the stored result or zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1982
name: close_library_handle_tail
description: Calls a tagged library function and releases the handle it returns when the call succeeds, then returns the stored result. It shares its tail with the routine before it.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:19CC
name: return_stored_result_after_release
description: Releases a pending resource when the flag is set and returns the stored result value. It is the final step of a larger routine.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1A14
name: store_glyph_metrics_for_code
description: For a character code, reads its glyph record and computes the left offset and width, rounding them by the style flags. It writes both values into the metric tables, and writes zeros when the glyph is absent.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1A8A
name: store_glyph_bounds_and_advance
description: Computes a glyph's left edge and advance from its record, clamps the running bounds, writes the offsets into the tables, and sets the bitmap pointer for the glyph row.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1ADA
name: copy_glyph_rows_to_bitmap
description: Copies a glyph's bit rows into the bitmap one row at a time, updating the running width and bounds. It continues until every row is written.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1B72
name: blit_glyph_rows_into_bitmap
description: Merges each row of a glyph's bit data into the destination bitmap by shifting 16-bit words into place. It then updates the stored width and bounds, and records the pen position when the glyph matches the current one.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1BDA
name: merge_glyph_row_bits
description: Merges the remaining glyph row words into the destination bitmap, advances the row pointers, and records the glyph's position when it matches the current one.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1BF8
name: merge_glyph_bits_and_finish
description: Merges glyph row bits into the destination bitmap until the rows run out, then records the glyph's position when it matches the current one and returns the result.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1C8C
name: store_glyph_slot_metrics
description: Writes the saved glyph offsets and widths into the metric tables for the current slot, and clears the saved state when the slot matches. Returns the result word.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1CC6
name: store_saved_glyph_offsets
description: Writes the saved offset and width values into the metric tables at the given slot and returns the result.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1CF8
name: load_font_glyph_tables
description: Loads the font named by its file name, clears a 256-entry table, and builds glyph offsets and widths for each character. It returns the result after the tables are filled.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1D14
name: load_font_file_glyph_data
description: Clears a 256-entry glyph table, opens the font file named by the entry, reads its size and style flags, and loads the glyph data for each character. It returns the loaded table, or zero on failure.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1D76
name: read_font_size_style_flags
description: Reads the font's size and style flags through library calls and takes the bounds from the font header or the saved defaults. It then continues into the glyph loading.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1D9C
name: read_font_bounds_from_header
description: Reads the font's style flags and two pairs of header bounds through library calls and stores them as the working bounds. It continues into glyph loading.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1E2A
name: store_font_header_bounds
description: Loads the font's bounds from its header, reading the extended bounds when the flag is set, and records them for the glyph loop.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1E64
name: compute_font_header_metrics
description: Computes the font's baseline, height and width from header values and extended bounds, and stores them for the glyph loop.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1F70
name: compute_font_height_bounds
description: Scans the glyph table entries for the lowest and highest vertical values, then stores the resulting font height and baseline offset.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1F9E
name: scan_glyph_height_extremes
description: Scans the glyph table entries for the lowest and highest vertical values, then stores the resulting font height and baseline offset. It is the pointer-walking form of the same height scan.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1FE2
name: store_font_height_and_metrics
description: Stores the computed font height, then reads the header metrics through library calls and records the baseline and width values for the font.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:1FF2
name: store_font_baseline_metrics
description: Stores the font baseline and reads the header metrics through library calls. When the flag is set it loads the optional extended values and fills the font header fields.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2068
name: build_font_header_and_name
description: References the font extension, computes the font's height and baseline, stores the font name into a buffer, and writes the header fields and glyph count. Results are returned through library calls.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:21EC
name: find_or_add_glyph_entry
description: Looks for a glyph entry whose height matches the current font height. When one is found it returns it, otherwise it reads the glyph's style fields and stores them as a new entry.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:21FE
name: find_matching_glyph_entry
description: Scans the glyph table for the entry that matches the font height and width, and records the baseline values from the first match. It then continues into the font header write.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2276
name: search_glyph_table_for_match
description: Walks the glyph table comparing each entry's height and width against the current font. When a match is found it records the match and continues into the glyph block write.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:22EE
name: read_font_tag_metrics
description: Reads the font's metric tags through library calls and sets the default size and style bits from them. It falls back to fixed defaults when a value is missing.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2396
name: initialise_font_metric_defaults
description: Sets the font metric flags from the tag lookups, then initialises the glyph table fields to their default values before the scan begins.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2474
name: collect_glyph_records_by_code
description: Loops over character codes, looks up each glyph record through a library call, stores its pointer in the glyph table, and tracks the lowest and highest bounds of the glyphs found.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2498
name: collect_glyph_records_with_ranges
description: Looks up glyph records for each character code through library calls. For codes in the lowercase letter range it also records the adjusted width and bounds, and it stores each pointer in the glyph table.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2584
name: compute_glyph_table_extents
description: Walks the glyph table by character code, tracking the lowest and highest values, and stores the font's base offset and extent. When the extent exceeds the width limit, it calls an unnamed routine for the fallback value.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2620
name: allocate_font_block_with_stub
description: Allocates a font block sized from the glyph count, writes the font header fields, and places a two-instruction return stub in it. It returns the block's data area, or the empty value when allocation fails.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2672
name: fill_font_block_glyph_data
description: Writes the font header into the block, then copies the glyph bitmap data for each character into it and stores their offsets. It returns the block.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:279C
name: sum_glyph_widths_for_font
description: Adds up the glyph widths across the character range and stores the total as the font width. It adjusts the result when the range covers the lowercase letters.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:27C6
name: sum_glyph_widths_into_header
description: Totals glyph widths over the character range and writes the total into the font header, with a fallback value for the lowercase range.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2838
name: finalize_font_width_and_release
description: Finds the largest combined glyph offset and width, clamps it to that maximum, and writes it into the font header. It then releases the glyph list and the temporary block through library calls.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2876
name: release_font_resources_tail
description: Writes the computed maximum width into the font header, then releases the glyph list and the temporary block through library calls.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:289C
name: compute_glyph_origin_offsets
description: Computes each glyph's origin by splitting the spare space between the glyph and its cell in half, and stores the two offsets. It falls through to the clipping code when an offset is negative.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2912
name: clip_glyph_offsets_to_cell
description: Clamps a glyph's x and y offsets so the glyph stays inside its cell, moving any excess into the other axis. It loops until the glyph rows are processed.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2952
name: store_glyph_offsets_and_advance
description: Writes the adjusted offsets into the output arrays and moves to the next glyph. When all glyphs are done it releases the working resources through library calls.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2962
name: clip_and_store_glyph_offsets
description: Clamps the offset when the cell has room, writes both values into the output arrays, and advances through the glyphs. It releases the working resources when the loop ends.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:298E
name: store_glyph_offsets_and_release
description: Writes the glyph offsets into the output arrays, advances the glyph index, and releases the working resources through library calls when the glyphs are finished.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:29B8
name: finish_font_header_and_release
description: Writes the computed font extent into the header, releases the glyph list and temporary block through library calls, and returns the result pointer.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2A94
name: initialise_font_block_header
description: Sets the self-pointer and the clamped count fields of a font block, clears its high flag, and sets its size. It then locks the library, fills the block through an unnamed routine, and returns the data pointer, or zero if the lock fails.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2AE4
name: set_font_block_size_fill
description: Sets the block size field, locks the library, fills the block through an unnamed routine, and unlocks. It returns the data pointer, or zero when the lock fails.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2B32
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero immediately without any other work.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2B46
name: find_font_entry_by_name
description: Copies the requested name into a buffer and walks the font list through library calls. When an entry has the expected type, it fills in the lookup and returns the match, and it releases the list when nothing is found.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2BE4
name: find_matching_font_record
description: Walks a list through library calls until it finds a record whose key and flag bits match the request. It returns the record, or zero when none matches.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2C1A
name: match_font_record_key
description: Scans records for one whose key and flags match the request, comparing the flagged values and continuing when they differ. It returns the matched value, or zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2D22
name: search_font_records_by_key
description: Scans the font record table for an entry whose key and flags match the request. When one matches it calls an unnamed routine to resolve it, and it returns that result, or zero when no record matches.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2D36
name: resolve_matching_font_record
description: Scans the font record table for a key and flag match, resolves each match through an unnamed routine, and returns the first non-zero result.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2E24
name: scan_font_records_for_resolution
description: Walks the font record table for matching key and flags and resolves each match through an unnamed routine. It returns the first non-zero result, or zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2E3C
name: try_font_style_variants
description: Tries the font lookup for several style variants (the base, a doubled size and a halved size), using flag bits to step through the combinations. It returns the first non-zero result, or zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2F18
name: try_font_size_variants_loop
description: Tries a font lookup at the stored size, double size and half size for each style bit set in the flags, and returns the first successful result.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2F2C
name: try_font_size_variants_fast
description: Tries a font lookup at the stored size, double size and half size when the flag bit is set, and returns the first successful result.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2F3E
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero immediately without any other work.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2F48
name: pick_widest_font_record
description: Measures each font record through a library call, keeps the one with the largest measured value, and passes it to an unnamed routine. It returns the unnamed routine's result, or the default when none is chosen.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2F70
name: select_largest_measured_font
description: Finds the largest measured value among the font records through a library call, passes the best one to an unnamed routine, and returns the result. It releases the temporary font when a result is found.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2FBA
name: select_font_by_measured_width
description: Measures the font records through a library call and chooses the widest one, passes it to an unnamed routine, and returns that result or zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:2FC0
name: select_font_by_max_measure
description: Chooses the font record with the largest measured value through a library call, passes it to an unnamed routine, and returns that result.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3006
name: select_largest_font_fallback
description: Measures a font through a library call, keeps the largest measured value, and passes the best candidate to an unnamed routine. It returns the result, or the fallback value when no candidate fits.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3086
name: select_font_by_measure_loop
description: Repeats the measured selection over the font records, choosing the largest measured value each pass. It returns the stored result once no further candidates remain.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:30A0
name: handle_font_request_entry
description: Entry handler for font requests that calls library routines for the lookup and reports the result. Most of its body is removed as unreachable in the decompiled form, so only the entry path is shown.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3144
name: parse_device_font_name
description: Splits a font name at its device colon, copies the name into a request buffer, and checks the font list for an entry of the matching type. It frees the temporary entry when the match is wrong and returns the result.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3166
name: open_fonts_directory_font
description: Opens a font named in the FONTS: directory by building a request, looking it up through library calls, and releasing any temporary entry. It returns the matched font, or zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:32A0
name: lookup_cached_font_entry
description: Looks up a font in the cache and sets the cache flag when the lookup succeeds. It updates the size fields when they differ from the stored entry, and returns the matched entry or zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:32F6
name: lookup_font_entry_and_update
description: Looks up a font entry, sets the cache flag when the entry is found, and updates the size fields when they changed. It returns the entry, or zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:335E
name: lookup_font_entry_cache_update
description: Looks up a font entry and updates its size fields when they differ. When the cache flag is set it resolves the pair of values through an unnamed routine, and it returns the entry or zero.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3454
name: release_font_request_and_return
description: Runs the lookup unnamed routine, releases the temporary font resource when one was allocated, closes the request through a library call, and returns the unnamed routine's result.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:34A8
name: convert_char_to_uppercase
description: Converts a lowercase letter to uppercase, including the extended Latin-1 letters except the division and small y with diaeresis. Other characters pass through unchanged.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:34F0
name: compare_strings_ignoring_case
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings one character at a time, uppercasing each first. Returns one when they match exactly and zero otherwise.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3502
name: compare_names_case_insensitive
description: Compares two zero-terminated names ignoring case and returns false on the first mismatch. It returns true only when both names end at the same point.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3526
name: match_string_ignoring_case
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings by uppercasing each character as it goes. Returns one when both end together, zero otherwise.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3538
name: return_one_value
description: Returns one immediately without any other work.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3544
name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer until a zero byte is encountered, including the terminator. Returns the original destination pointer.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3554
name: compare_strings_ordered
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. Returns zero when they are equal, a negative value when the first is smaller, and one when it is larger.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:356A
name: return_sign_from_flags
description: Returns negative one when the comparison flags show less-than, otherwise one. It is the tail of a compare routine and has no inputs of its own.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3574
name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Finds the terminating zero of the destination buffer, then copies the source string, including its terminator, to that point. Returns the original destination pointer.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:358C
name: find_byte_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for the given byte value. Returns a pointer to the first match, or null when the terminator is reached first.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:35A4
name: scan_string_for_byte_forward
description: Scans a zero-terminated string forward for a byte value and returns a pointer to the first match, or null when the terminator comes first.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:35B2
name: forward_call_with_two_args
description: Forwards its two arguments to an unnamed routine and returns nothing. It is a thin wrapper.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:35CC
name: find_last_byte_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string and returns a pointer to the last occurrence of the byte value, or null when it does not appear.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:35EC
name: return_nothing_stub
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:35F4
name: fill_bytes_with_value
description: Fills a block of bytes with the given value for the given count, and returns the start pointer.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3604
name: fill_bytes_loop_tail
description: Stores the byte value into consecutive memory locations, one per loop step, for the count given. It is the body of the fill routine and returns nothing.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3610
name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values by combining the cross products of their 16-bit halves, and returns the 32-bit fixed-point product.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3630
name: divide_fixed_point_values
description: Divides one 32-bit fixed-point value by another, handling negative operands by negating the result. It normalises the divisor by shifting before the division.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3648
name: negate_64bit_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine that returns a 64-bit value and returns the negation of its two longs.

key: worms - levels disk (1996-03-07)(various)[h nfa][addon levels][wb]/Worms - Levels Disk (1996-03-07)(Various)[h NFA][addon levels][WB].adf:LiBs/diskfont.library:0:3652
name: divide_fixed_point_quotient
